fedele:
ABSOLUTE PRIORITY: the main subject(s) in the attached photo must remain completely faithful and recognizable. Likeness matters more than style or decoration.

Identify the real subject(s) in the photo accurately:
- If people are present, count every single person and draw every single one with no one omitted, merged or added. Copy each person's exact face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, real expression (do not alter it or force a smile), hairstyle, hair length and parting, bangs, glasses (exact shape and frame), beard, accessories (headbands, earrings), apparent age and real body/child proportions (large head, round cheeks). Never beautify, idealize, age, slim or stylize faces. Keep each person's relative position, pose and size as in the photo.
- If animals, pets, plush toys, objects or landscapes are the subject, preserve their exact species/breed, fur or pattern markings, silhouette, pose, proportions and key visual details cleanly without inventing extra people or extra characters not present in the photo.

Output format: a printable coloring book page in pure black outlines (#111111 / pure black) on a pure white (#FFFFFF) background. No grey, no shading, no gradients, no stippling, no solid black filled areas, no text, no watermarks and no logos. Clean closed shapes, uniform crisp line weight, portrait 3:4 orientation with generous white space ready for coloring.

FAITHFUL PHOTO MODE (NO FANTASY THEME): Strictly reproduce ONLY the real subject(s), their real clothing/accessories and the real setting/background actually visible in the attached photo, cleanly translated into crisp coloring-book outlines. Simplify distracting textures into clear colorable shapes while keeping the real scene truthful. DO NOT invent or add any fantasy theme, pirates, ships, unicorns, dragons, knights, space rockets, aliens, dinosaurs, castles, crowns, costume changes, hats or imaginary creatures/props not present in the photo.
